candidates.title: Memory Still Exists; That Does Not Make It Inheritable
candidates.title_zh: 记忆还在，不等于还能继承
candidates.researchQuestion: 当数字员工更换模型、读写方式或嵌入模型后，需要哪些证据，才能让原有持久记忆成为新运行环境的权威记忆？
candidates.coreProposition: Physical persistence, semantic compatibility, recoverability, and activation authority are four distinct states; durable memory must be re-admitted after a model, writer, reader, or embedding change before it becomes authoritative for the new runtime.

sections.heading: Byte Continuity Is Not Meaning Continuity
sections.heading_zh: 字节连续，不等于意义连续

sections.heading: Migration Direction Cannot Be Averaged Away
sections.heading_zh: 迁移方向为什么不能被平均值抹平

sections.heading: Four States Cannot Be Compressed into Available
sections.heading_zh: 四个状态，不能压成一个“可用”

sections.heading: The Minimum Migration Evidence Packet
sections.heading_zh: 最小迁移证据包应该记录什么

sections.heading: Retaining Raw History Is Not a Guaranteed Repair
sections.heading_zh: “保留原始历史就一定能修好”同样过强

sections.heading: Upgrade Completion Needs a Stronger Definition
sections.heading_zh: 升级完成的定义需要改变

sections.heading: Evidence Boundary and Open Questions
sections.heading_zh: 证据边界与开放问题

evidenceClaims.claim: Free-form notes show strong directional swap asymmetry: one reported direction improves by about 9.91 percentage points while the reverse declines by about 13.28 points.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，自由文本笔记存在明显方向性：一个迁移方向提高约 9.91 个百分点，反向迁移下降约 13.28 个百分点。

evidenceClaims.claim: A mixed index from two same-dimension embedding versions recovers only part of the gain from full re-embedding; the reported full-versus-mixed difference is about 6.95 percentage points.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，两个同维度嵌入版本形成的混合索引只获得完整重新嵌入的部分收益，完整迁移比混合条件高约 6.95 个百分点。

evidenceClaims.claim: Retained raw source enables several tested recovery paths but does not guarantee repair across repair models.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，保留原始来源为多种恢复路径提供条件，但不能保证不同修复模型都能成功。

evidenceClaims.claim: Storage shape and semantic compatibility are different evidence identities; successful parsing or matching vector dimensions cannot establish preserved retrieval meaning.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次分析观察到，存储形态与语义兼容属于不同证据；成功解析或向量维度相同不能证明检索意义保持不变。

evidenceClaims.claim: Governed digital employees should treat semantic-stack changes as directional memory migrations requiring re-admission before activation.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，受治理的数字员工应把语义栈变化视为有方向的记忆迁移，并在激活前重新准入。

candidates.title: Role Match Is Not Team Fit
candidates.title_zh: 角色匹配，不等于团队适配
candidates.researchQuestion: 当一个智能体被替换、故障转移或调入另一支团队时，怎样区分“能做这个角色”与“能适配这支团队已经形成的协作方式”？
candidates.coreProposition: Role and capability qualification do not establish destination-team compatibility; replacement activation requires separate evidence for team coordination, carried-state scope, and recovery of both outcome and coordination efficiency.

sections.heading: The Same Role Can Still Arrive as an Outsider
sections.heading_zh: 同一角色，为什么仍然像“外来者”

sections.heading: The Task Survives While the Cost Changes
sections.heading_zh: 任务没失败，成本却已经变了

sections.heading: Four Gates Decide Whether Replacement Becomes Active
sections.heading_zh: 四道门决定替换能否生效

sections.heading: Handoff Is Not Copy as Much State as Possible
sections.heading_zh: 交接不是“状态越多越好”

sections.heading: Restoring Output and Restoring the Team Are Different Events
sections.heading_zh: 恢复输出，与恢复团队，是两件事

sections.heading: One Policy Can Implement the Checks; Evidence Still Needs Separate Accounts
sections.heading_zh: 一个统一策略可以实施，证据仍需分账

sections.heading: Evidence Boundary and Open Questions
sections.heading_zh: 证据边界与开放问题

evidenceClaims.claim: Role-matched swaps preserve much task performance while increasing communication cost per unit of progress by approximately 16–63% in the controlled study.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 受控研究报告，角色匹配互换保持了大部分任务表现，但单位进展的沟通成本增加约 16%—63%。

evidenceClaims.claim: Partner specificity rises with coordination coupling and longer team formation history in the reported ablations.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，在消融比较中，协作耦合越强、团队共同形成时间越长，伙伴专属性越明显。

evidenceClaims.claim: Replacing the more coordination-central seat produces a larger penalty, and incumbents can emit much of the extra communication.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，替换协作中心性更高的席位代价更大，而且额外沟通可能主要由原成员发出。

evidenceClaims.claim: Task outcome recovers earlier than coordination efficiency after replacement in the reported settings.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，在所测试条件中，替换后的任务结果比协作效率更早恢复。

evidenceClaims.claim: Replacement disruption can be a relationship mismatch rather than an individual-worker defect.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次分析观察到，替换扰动可能是关系失配，而不是新成员自身能力缺陷。

evidenceClaims.claim: Governed failover should bind activation to destination-team compatibility, scoped state inheritance, and a two-dimensional recovery window.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，受治理的故障转移应把激活绑定到目标团队适配、有范围的状态继承，以及同时观察结果与协作的恢复窗口。

candidates.title: Changing the Control Surface Must Not Split One Business Effect
candidates.title_zh: 换了操作界面，不能换掉同一次业务效果
candidates.researchQuestion: 当智能体在图形界面、命令行和工具调用之间切换，并共同修改同一份应用状态时，怎样保证这些动作仍属于同一次可审计的业务效果？
candidates.coreProposition: Business effect identity should remain stable across GUI, CLI, and tool/MCP surface switches over the same target state; surface-specific evidence belongs to one effect-centered provenance chain, while authorization, idempotency, and commit evidence remain separate gates.

sections.heading: A Control Modality Is Not a Transaction Identity
sections.heading_zh: 操作方式不是事务身份

sections.heading: The Benchmark Makes Shared State Visible
sections.heading_zh: 研究环境怎样把共享状态暴露出来

sections.heading: What One Effect Chain Must Preserve
sections.heading_zh: 一次效果，需要哪些共同身份

sections.heading: When Evidence Conflicts, Authority Must Be Declared
sections.heading_zh: 证据冲突时，谁是权威

sections.heading: Unified Provenance Is Not Unified Authority
sections.heading_zh: 统一出处，不等于统一权限

sections.heading: A Practical Migration Path for Runtimes
sections.heading_zh: 运行系统可以怎样开始改造

sections.heading: Boundaries and Unresolved Questions
sections.heading_zh: 边界与尚未解决的问题

evidenceClaims.claim: CUA-Universe models GUI and CLI actions as operating over one persistent application state and records them in one task trajectory.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: CUA-Universe 报告的机制让图形界面与命令行共同作用于一个持久应用状态，并把动作记录在同一任务轨迹中。

evidenceClaims.claim: Trained hybrid orchestration materially outperforms merely exposing both surfaces to the base model in the reported comparisons.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，在受控比较中，经过混合编排训练的模型明显优于只向基础模型开放两种操作方式。

evidenceClaims.claim: The benchmark verifier combines screenshots, command output, and exported-artifact evidence and reports high agreement with human labels on its validation sample while retaining known limitations.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，基准验证器结合截图、命令输出和导出工件，并在验证样本上与人工标签保持较高一致性，同时存在已知限制。

evidenceClaims.claim: When surfaces share state, presentation freshness can diverge from authoritative-state freshness, so a surface-local observation cannot independently define effect identity.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次分析观察到，共享状态下的界面展示新鲜度可能落后于权威状态，因此单一界面观察不能独立定义业务效果身份。

evidenceClaims.claim: Governed runtimes should carry one effect identity across surfaces while keeping authorization, idempotency, external commit, and recovery authority as separate evidence gates.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，受治理的运行系统应让同一效果身份跨越不同操作界面，同时把授权、幂等、外部提交和恢复权限保留为独立门禁。
